facts.fact: CIO Africa says Kenya's Data Protection Act is applied through section 50 and Regulation 26.
CIO Africa says the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner administers the Act.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: CIO Africa says the ODPC published a Guidance Note on Cross-border Data Transfers in April 2026.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: CIO Africa says Kenya has not ratified the Malabo Convention.
